0|2d332d5bc424404911540006a8bb450fbb96b178|torvalds~linux|/home/usuario01/Titan-Files-Research/src/_00/output/C/torvalds~linux|False|"ceph: fscrypt_auth handling for ceph
Most fscrypt-enabled filesystems store the crypto context in an xattr
but that's problematic for ceph as xatts are governed by the XATTR cap
but we really want the crypto context as part of the AUTH cap.
Because of this
column2: the MDS has added two new inode metadata fields:

column1: fscrypt_auth and fscrypt_file. The former is used to hold the crypto
context
column2: and the latter is used to track the real file size.

column1: Parse new fscrypt_auth and fscrypt_file fields in inode traces. For now
we don't use fscrypt_file
column2: but fscrypt_auth is used to hold the fscrypt

column1: context.
Allow the client to use a setattr request for setting the fscrypt_auth
field. Since this is not a standard setattr request from the VFS
a new field to __ceph_setattr that carries ceph-specific inode attrs.
Have the set_context op do a setattr that sets the fscrypt_auth value
and get_context just return the contents of that field (since it should
always be available).
